nodes.description: Biallelic nonsense, frameshift or destabilising missense variants in PPP1R13L abolish functional iASPP. Patient fibroblasts with the founder p.Tyr747Ter allele contain no detectable iASPP protein, and disease-causing mutants either lose the C-terminal ankyrin-SH3 domain, become more auto-inhibited, or aggregate because that domain is destabilised. The C-terminal domain is the binding hub through which iASPP engages partners that include the NF-kappaB subunit p65. iASPP is named for its inhibition of p53, but no study has tested whether loss of that activity contributes to this disease.
